change_summary: Kerr leg (SKS N=1, a=0.9375) ray comparison at C=80 with the literal dag.md thresholds
expected: max|x_R-x_B|<=1e-3 on escaped rays, escape angle<=1e-6, |k.k|/k_t^2<=1e-8 on every ray at C=80
observed: class 100% identical, order 4.0/3.8 (RAPTOR) 4.0/4.0 (BLP); max|dx| 3.9e-3 and angle 2.3e-6 only on near-critical rays (grid/random: 2.3e-5, 2.6e-8); null norm escaped rays 1.6e-8 RAPTOR vs 2.3e-8 BLP, capture tail (E_n>10) 0.14 RAPTOR vs 0.025 BLP
root_cause: RK4 discretisation at C=80: on near-critical rays each code's own error vs the Vern7 reference is 3.2e-3 (RAPTOR) / 7e-4 (BLP) and |dx|/(2 max eps) <= 0.84 on every ray; BLP's own null drift exceeds 1e-8 on escaped rays; capture-tail drift at E_n>10 in both codes
fix_hypothesis: Evaluate with the design.md section 5 attribution rule (|X_R-X_B| <= 2 max(eps_R, eps_B)) and the literal thresholds at C=160; report the capture-tail null drift separately

change_summary: All three legs with the section-5 attribution evaluation (first version of the comparison script)
expected: dx and escape angle within 2 max(eps_R, eps_B) of each code's own error against the Vern7 reference
observed: dx/(2 eps) 2.1-3.7 on s455/s122; angle ratio ~1e300; s455 had 1 near-critical ray instead of 50
root_cause: comparison-script defects: states compared at equal step index while lambda_R and lambda_B differ by up to 3e-3 (steps follow the state); acos(dot) cannot resolve angles below 1.5e-8 so reference angles rounded to 0; the far hole's shadow is displaced by the companion's lensing so its projected centre is not captured
fix_hypothesis: compare at equal lambda (move the RAPTOR state by -k dlambda), angle via atan(|u x v|, u.v), seed the critical-curve bisection from a captured grid point near each projected centre

change_summary: Equal-lambda trajectory comparison, atan angles, lensing-aware critical seeds; literal and attributed verdicts on kerr, s455, s122
expected: all legs pass the attributed rule for the FD build
observed: class identical 100%; samples equal 100%; order C40-80 4.01-4.02, C80-160 3.57-3.83 (FD), 4.01 (analytic), BLP 4.02-4.04; C80 max dx 2.3e-3..3.4e-3 with dx/(2 max eps) <= 0.68; C160 dx <= 5.7e-5, angle <= 5.2e-8; escaped-ray null 1.2e-8 RAPTOR vs 2.1e-8 BLP at C80, <= 7.3e-10 at C160; capture-tail null up to 0.59 (RAPTOR) / 0.37 (BLP) at E_n up to 100

change_summary: M5 reader + M6 four-vectors/plasma decode vs BlackLightPlus at 1e5 points on s455, b.b as a left-to-right sum
expected: every column bit-identical (same operation order as BLP)
observed: block and primitives bit-identical; b_sq 72% bit-identical, max rel 2.0e-15 (sigma, beta_inv, B follow); all dag thresholds met
root_cause: LinearAlgebra.dot inlined into primitive_four_vectors compiles to an FMA chain (the @simd reduction is contracted); a stand-alone dot is a plain sum (measured on 2e5 random vectors: FMA chain 100%, plain sum 54%)

change_summary: BLP reference on s122 (a_A = 0.4) including 1000 points per excision ball
observed: DomainError sqrt(-158.6) in primitive_four_vectors: -g^00 < 0 at 9 of ~9000 test points with r_A < 0.07 (r_h = 0.8), near the ring of a spinning hole
root_cause: the superposed Kerr-Schild inverse has g^00 >= 0 deep inside a spinning hole's horizon; BLP never samples there (the march stops at the horizon)
fix_hypothesis: reference records NaN four-vectors there; RAPTOR decode treats NaN b^2 as vacuum
notes: not a reader fault: the lapse does not exist at those points; candidate tag domain_of_definition

change_summary: Orientation tests with the upstream camera readout (cam_up -z, Kerr observer) to derive RAPTOR's Stokes handedness
expected: signs of test 1 and ratios of test 2 as BlackLightPlus
observed: Q_R = -Q_BLP and U_R = -U_BLP on every slab and the ring (to 7e-8), V equal; ring I 5 orders low on the first run
root_cause: upstream observer tetrad is (e_1 west, e_2 north), the IAU basis rotated by 90 deg; the low ring flux came from the analytic model keeping the previous scene's d_unit (fixture bug, fixed in 82b8ba2)
fix_hypothesis: M8: normal observer, up = image north, readout in (e_2, -e_1)

change_summary: M8 STOKES_IAU readout; orientation tests 1 and 2
expected: identical signs and matching Stokes on every slab
observed: all signs agree; ring within 7e-8; Faraday-screen V/I 0.160 (RAPTOR) vs 0.016 (BLP), unchanged from C=80 to C=5120
root_cause: M21 fits give |j_V| = 10.7 j_I in the field-aligned screen (sin theta_B = 0.02); BlackLightPlus's reverse march clamps |P|<=I on partial foreground sums, so its result depends on segment order (test/test_emission_admissibility.jl reproduces V/I 0.019 vs 0.197)
fix_hypothesis: rescale j_P onto j_I in BlackLightPlus stokes_segment (fix commit 2fab069) and mirror it in EMIS_BLP (82c904f)
